name: Marianne Bennett
source:
MBTI: ENFP

"But it's the same as what Quill said! I hope that we all get along really well and if it turns out we're trapped in here or anything, that I get to know all of you too!"

The empathetic gardener who handles anyone she meets with care. Regardless of the situation, Marianne always seems to extend kindness and gentle words of reassurance to others. Claiming she didn't notice anything abnormal before finding herself here, Marianne only hopes that everyone will be able to get along well and escape their situation safely.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
